description.en: Browses the images a DSH project or session has seen, generated or delivered: hover preview on workspace rows, a session panel, and a global album whose lightbox pairs each image with the conversation behind it. Reads local files only.
description.zh: 按项目或会话浏览 DSH 里 AI 看过、生成过、交付过的图：工作区行悬停预览、会话面板、全局相册；灯箱里每张图都带对应那段对话。只读本机文件。
